description: Music licence allow-list for the import tool, approved at Decision D3 (2026-10-20): CC0 1.0, or public domain only when BOTH the composition and the recording are independently verified. The importer enforces this list: a track whose licence identifier is not present, or whose composition OR recording rights are not fully covered, is refused. Attribution (CC-BY), non-commercial (NC), no-derivatives (ND) and share-alike (SA) licences are excluded because the rendered output is a derivative commercial work distributed without per-track attribution. Approving the policy does not approve any track: each real track is imported only after its own sign-off (music-starter-signoff.md).

excluded.reason: attribution required; rendered output carries no per-track attribution
share-alike would force the output licence
no-derivatives forbids mixing into an edit
